name: notes-search
description: Pesquisa inteligente nas notas técnicas e tags publicadas em ronanrodrigo.dev.
author: Ronan Rodrigo

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search notes
tools.description: Search published notes using exact, partial, token and fuzzy matching.

query.description: Terms or phrase to search for.

tag.description: Optional exact or fuzzy tag filter.

tools.name: search_tags
tools.title: Search note tags
tools.description: Search the published tag index with exact, partial and fuzzy matching.

query.description: Tag or topic to search for.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.title: List note tags
tools.description: List all published tags, optionally ranked by fuzzy relevance.

tools.name: get_note
tools.title: Get note content
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a published note by slug (also accepts the post URL or markdown_url).

slug.description: Note slug, post URL or markdown_url.
